title: Jazzy Sweet Saudi-Arabian Milk Bake
description: A rich and decadent Saudi-Arabian milk bake perfect for brunch, featuring sweetened condensed milk and a crispy gluten-free crust.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, granulated sugar, and ground cardamom.
Add the unsalted butter and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Press the mixture into the bottom of a 9x9-inch baking dish.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the crust is lightly golden brown.
In a separate bowl, whisk together sweetened condensed milk and eggs.
Pour the milk mixture over the baked crust.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 25-30 minutes, or until the top is lightly golden brown and the center is set.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Slice into squares and serve warm.
